summary: Add hosts on the inventory's Hosts tab with Create host, either new (toggle On to include in jobs, Name, Variables such as ansible_user, ansible_ssh_pass, ansible_become_pass) or existing; hosts can be disassociated and ad hoc commands run from there.
questions: How do I add a host to an inventory in AAP?
